summary: Lincoln County, OR lookout site: a 54-ft steel tower the register dates to 1942; moved to Euchre in 1965 or dismantled in 1967, sources differ; now gone.

facts.design: 54-foot steel tower with 7 x 7 cab; the first lookout (1939) was 20-foot fir poles with a 7 x 7 open platform and tent floor
facts.status_note: Register says the lookout is now gone; one source says the tower was moved to Euchre Lookout in 1965, another says it was dismantled and salvaged in 1967

events.note: First lookout: 20-foot fir poles, 7 x 7 open platform, 10 x 12 tent floor; total cost $95.00 (Lincoln FPA annual report, quoted on Rex's page)
Register dates the 54-foot steel tower with 7 x 7 cab to 1942; a 1942 Lincoln FPA report also describes an 18 x 20 ft lookout cabin
Activated September 10, 1942, with the Eugene Filter Center listed beside the date
Rex's page quotes a 1954 entry saying the lookout was under construction late that season, which conflicts with the register's 1942 date; an undated entry gives the cost of a 54-foot steel tower
Register says the tower was moved to Euchre Lookout in 1965. The Euchre Mountain record notes a tower built there in 1965 for $1067.58 but does not name Norton Hill
Rex's page says the lookout was dismantled and salvaged in 1967

corrections.why: 6.1 m (20 ft) matches the 1939 fir-pole lookout; the register and Rex's page both describe a 54-foot steel tower, about 16.5 m

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 6.1 m is the 1939 fir-pole structure. The story and facts use the 54-foot steel tower that both the register and Rex's page describe.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the build year (register 1942 vs Rex's 1954 entry) and on the fate (moved to Euchre in 1965 vs dismantled in 1967). Nothing ties the Euchre 1965 tower to Norton Hill. Brief height 6.1 m is the 1939 pole lookout. Registration date checked on the FFLOS page. No new photos added; the register already carries the 1942-1965 and 1997 photos.
